PURITY / GRADE

Bitumen 80/100 is a petroleum-derived paving grade bitumen supplied for infrastructure buyers requiring verified grade identity, adhesion, durability, and workable asphalt binder performance.

RELEVANT STANDARDS

Compliance can be reviewed against international penetration or viscosity grade specifications, recognized ASTM, AASHTO, ISO, EN, and project authority test method requirements where applicable.

TYPICAL EXPORT PACKAGING

New steel drums, jumbo bags, bitubags, bitutainers, flexibags, or bulk supply subject to grade, volume, route, and destination handling.

PRIMARY APPLICATIONS

Highways and Expressways, Airport Pavements, Urban and Municipal Roads, Industrial and Port Pavements

Values shown are typical reference ranges, not a commercial guarantee. Test methods are named as references, not certifications. The Certificate of Analysis for the confirmed lot governs.

SPECIFICATION VALUE / RANGE TEST METHOD

Loss on heating Reported on COA ASTM D6

INSIGHT FOR BUYERS

Malaysia & international reference standards

PetroBind's Bitumen 60/70 grades are selected based on strict physical properties that match the technical thresholds required by standard Malaysian paving frameworks (MS 124 & JKR/SPJ/2008). The same penetration, softening point, ductility, flash point and solubility tests are referenced internationally under ASTM D946, AASHTO M20 and EN 12591.
